description: Type text into an input/textarea element by its index (from session_state output), focusing it and dispatching input/change events. events:"full" is the complete human typing gesture: per-character keydown/keypress/input/keyup cycles, trailing change, then blur — the tail blur commits on forms that save in onBlur (React capture listeners, #100). A disabled, readonly, or detached field answers `filled:false` with a `reason` instead of a silent write. Hidden inputs are legitimate targets and are filled normally.

events.description:
Event fidelity: "full" types one character at a time with a
keydown/keypress/input/keyup cycle per character, for pages whose
listeners key on keyboard events (e.g. keypress-Enter login forms).
Default fires a single input+change pair after the value is set.

text.description: Text to type into the input field
